spec: Pre-registered K-realization re-score (E2_NOTES.md, approved 2026-11-25 16:44, before any E2.6 re-score ran): K = 5 NumPy float64 realizations of the dev tier (seeds 5000-5049 x 3 start tilts = N 150, 60 s); realization k adds k x 1e-15 rad to every scenario's initial tilt (k = 0..4, k = 0 is the plain dev tier); same machine, CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=-1. Candidates: every run's final.npz and its saved checkpoint candidates, plus the frozen MB PID baseline. Selection key: mean over realizations of the mean dev cost; ties equal at the reported 3-decimal precision go to fewer total falls. Per-run machine and stop_reason reported for disclosure.
